ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels with high-intensity contrast found only at the background boundary and distal calcified clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform high-density dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface; no macro-scale mottling or contiguous white geometric blobs; localized high-intensity circular points representing specular reflections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; vertex angle approximately 40 degrees; significant depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing boundary; small-amplitude peaks and valleys distributed with medium frequency across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge originating from the median notch and sweeping upwards toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel groupings concentrated on the far lateral margins (tips) of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct diagonal high-intensity linear mark observed on the upper-mid region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral calcification clusters at the distal tips; single prominent linear scar on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, isolated high-intensity circular spots across the fluke surface consistent with specular reflections from water droplets.
